t: Approvals sends leave, expense and purchase requests to the right person, as a card in chat.
In this video, you will learn how to make a request, approve or reject one, and set the rules.
Click Work in the left menu, then Approvals.
Waiting for me lists requests you need to decide. My requests shows your own, and Decided by me the ones you answered.
Press New request. Choose leave, expense, purchase or other, fill in the dates or amount, and press Send for approval.
It goes to your manager as a card in chat. Above the workspace amount, expenses and purchases also go to your manager's manager.
Open a request to see its steps. Press Approve or Reject, with a note if you like.
Approved leave turns on out of office for those days, by itself.
Admins press Rules to set the second-level amount, and who approves for people with no manager.
Next in the Work menu: Roles.
